{"description":"MINOR, because it adds a tool, an optional schema property and a capability. The schema STAMP DOES NOT MOVE — 28 node types, 65 edge types — so no migration is owed by this release.

🛑 IT IS ALSO THE FIX FOR v0.55.0 AND v0.55.1. Those releases retired QualityGate, and the guard refused on the schema STAMP rather than on the DATA. Every graph written before the retirement names the type in its stamp whether or not it ever held one, so every graph was refused — reported from the field within hours, costing a full working session, and it was the SECOND time a version guard had locked that same user out. From v0.56.0 only a graph that genuinely HOLDS a retired type is refused, and by every measurement taken no design ever held a QualityGate. docs/upgrading-to-v0.55.0.md now carries a supersession banner saying try opening first.

THE CAUSE WAS NOT THAT A CHECK WAS TOO STRICT. dec:sidecar-loss-guarded-by-store-evidence is ACCEPTED and already rules that a refusal must be conditioned on what the store actually holds. It stopped at the identity sidecar and never reached the version one — so this change is recorded as GOVERNED_BY that decision rather than deciding anything new.

AND A NODE CAN NOW RECORD WHAT THE USER CALLS IT. reflow2's vocabulary is abstract on purpose so it spans a house, a spacecraft and a service, which leaves every user translating their field's nouns into it; one wrote a private translator skill, putting the mapping outside the design where nothing could read or check it. `record_alias` gives it a home on the five types that name a THING. Terms MERGE — a second word never costs the first — and it renames nothing and gates nothing.

WHAT IS STILL OPEN, stated because the field report said it plainly: a deliberate startup refusal still reaches an MCP client as CONNECT_TIMEOUT, which is what sent every session that night looking at networking, and may have cost more than the guard itself.","name":"v0.56.0 — the version guard asks the store instead of the stamp, and a node can record what the user calls it","status":"planned","unit_type":"binary","version":"0.56.0"}
